'''Sterla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]], following the Coronation of Empress [[Vaylin]] he was hand-picked by her to join the new [[Horizon Guard]]. However, Sterla soon went into exile following the disgraced Battalion Commander [[Tassar (Human)|Tassar]]. Tassar's followers revered her zealously as a cult formed around her. Eventually they intercepted an Alliance transport with samples for [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]], allowing Tassar to discover [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]] and the technology of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], which she wanted to use to upgrade the [[Star Fortress]] design to be completely indestructible.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: Commander Tassar}}</ref> Tassar and her followers made significant progress in constructing a new Star Fortress on Rakata Prime's surface, however following the death of Vaylin in [[3630 BBY]] they were discovered by the [[Eternal Alliance]] forces. A strike team was dispatched to stop Tassar and her efforts, which confronted and killed Sterla.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Scout Captain Sterla appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a boss during the "Landing Party" Uprising.
